tokens.name: hf-primary
tokens.usage: Humaflow navy, the one brand hue. Primary buttons, the active nav item, focus rings, links and active tabs. Tenants replace it at runtime; dark is the default tenant's derived value (70% navy, 30% white).

tokens.name: hf-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an hf-primary fill (13.2:1 light, 10.1:1 dark). Never hard-code white on navy: dark mode flips it to near-black.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Legacy name for hf-primary-foreground, used by .hf-btn-primary, toasts and avatars on navy.

tokens.name: hf-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: hf-primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: hf-primary-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest navy: the Home greeting h1, ring values, the toast background.

tokens.name: hf-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Pale navy wash: selected rows and menu items, the input focus halo, info panels. Navy text reads 11.9:1 on it.

tokens.name: hf-primary-soft-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger wash: text selection, hovered selected items.

tokens.name: hf-primary-border
tokens.usage: Navy-tinted border: hover outline on selectable cards, disabled primary button fill.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Tenant accent (DEFAULT_ACCENT), set at runtime as --teal. Self-development KPAs and avatars only; never a second primary. 5.0:1 on surface.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind cards and the main screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, topbar, modals.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed surface: modal footers, side panels, hover fill for ghost buttons and rows, progress-bar tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default hairline: card borders, table rows, dividers.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: input borders, sidebar and topbar edges, outline buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-2 (17.4:1 light, 16.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, inactive nav items and tabs, metadata (6.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: eyebrows, placeholders, hints, due dates. Light value is only 3.1:1 on surface and 2.8:1 on bg, below 4.5:1: keep it to 11-12px labels that repeat information shown elsewhere, or use ink-2.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: On track, success, acting-as badge. As text on green-bg: 3.1:1 light (below 4.5:1, kept from source; always pair with a dot or label), 7.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: green-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind green status text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: At risk, warning, due-soon dates. As text on amber-bg: 2.5:1 light (fails AA, kept from source; always pair with the label word), 8.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: amber-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind amber status text.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Off track, errors, destructive actions, unread dots. On red-bg: 3.7:1 light, 7.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: red-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind red status text and error banners.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: No status. On grey-bg: 2.7:1 light (below AA, kept from source).

tokens.name: grey-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind No status pills and muted badges.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Closed status and neutral tags (4.9:1 on slate-bg light, 8.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: slate-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind slate text.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: shadcn page background. Same as bg.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn default text. Same as ink.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn Card, Table wrapper and StatCard fill.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown, Select, Popover and toast fill.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn primary. Always an alias of hf-primary so tenant branding flows into shadcn components.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button and badge fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Navy text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tab list track, table row hover, StatCard default icon tile, skeletons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Descriptions, table header labels, inactive tabs. Reads 5.8:1 on muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for outline, ghost and secondary buttons; primary icon tiles.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Navy text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive button and badge fill.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive. White on #d6483b is 4.3:1, just under 4.5:1 (kept from source; labels are 14px medium).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border inside shadcn surfaces (.sb-scope sets it on every element).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input and select borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a 2px solid outline, offset 3px, on every focusable element (12:1 on bg).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series. The five chart colours are CVD-validated as an ordered set: assign 1..N in order, never pick out of order.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series. The only sanctioned violet: tests/palette.test.ts bans purple and indigo hexes everywhere else.

tokens.name: navy-50

tokens.name: navy-100

tokens.name: navy-200
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of hf-primary-border.

tokens.name: navy-600

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of hf-primary-active.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of hf-primary-deep.

tokens.name: nav-primary
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item fill, nav count badges, the product mark.

tokens.name: nav-primary-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon on nav-primary.

tokens.name: nav-accent
tokens.usage: Sidebar item hover fill.

tokens.name: nav-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive sidebar item text and icon.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Filled rating stars only.

tokens.name: toast-check
tokens.usage: Check icon inside the navy toast.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal overlay (.hf-overlay, with a 2px backdrop blur). Drawers use 0.34 alpha, the command palette 0.36.

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: Home screen h1 only, in hf-primary-deep.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The text wordmark in the sidebar, in navy, above the caption 'Performance Management'.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Settings section headings in the Admin center.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card header title. shadcn CardTitle uses 15px semibold with leading-none.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Legacy page tabs; also the greeting subtitle at 400.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Agree your KPAs with your manager before the cycle opens.
styles.usage: Default UI text. Body sets tabular numerals (tnum) and cv11 globally.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels and list item titles at 600.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Your manager will be notified when you submit.
styles.usage: Modal subtitles, StatCard labels, empty-state text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Status pills, progress percentages, due dates, legends.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Weights across all KPIs must total 100%.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and admin nav group labels (800 there), in ink-3.

spacing.note: Tailwind v4's default 4px scale drives shadcn components; .hf-* CSS uses literal pixel values. These are the layout constants that recur.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Tailwind v4 spacing unit: p-5 = 20px, gap-3.5 = 14px.

tokens.name: sb-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar width (--sb-w). Below 900px the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Topbar height.

tokens.name: screen-max
tokens.usage: Max width of .hf-screen; 1340px for .hf-screen-wide.

tokens.name: screen-pad-left
tokens.usage: .hf-screen padding is 30px 70px 60px 34px.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Card padding (.hf-card padding, shadcn Card py-5/px-5).

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard cards.

tokens.name: modal-pad-x
tokens.usage: Modal header and footer side padding (head 20px 26px, foot 16px 26px).

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Side drawer width. Default Modal width is 920px.

radius.note: Two scales coexist: shadcn's, derived from --radius (14px), and the app's --r-* scale. Tenant theming rewrites r-sm and r-md at runtime from the tenant radius (default 10: r-sm 7px, r-md 10px, r-lg 14px).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: shadcn base radius (14px).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: shadcn rounded-sm.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: shadcn rounded-md: Button, Input, Badge, Tooltip, Tabs triggers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: shadcn rounded-lg: Dialog, Tabs list, StatCard icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: shadcn rounded-xl: Card, StatCard, data-table wrapper.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Legacy buttons, inputs, tabs, menu rows. Runtime default 7px.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Selectable cards, upload panels. Runtime default 10px.

tokens.name: r-card
tokens.usage: Legacy .hf-card.

tokens.name: r-modal
tokens.usage: Legacy .hf-modal (literal 18px in CSS).

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, segmented control, progress bars, nav badges, toasts.

tokens.name: sh-sm
tokens.usage: Active nav item, active segmented button.

tokens.name: sh-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest. Barely there: cards are separated by border first.

tokens.name: sh-pop
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers, toasts, hovered review card.

tokens.name: sh-drawer
tokens.usage: Right-hand drawer.

tokens.name: z-sidebar

tokens.name: z-drawer

tokens.name: z-mobile-scrim

tokens.name: z-toast

breakpoint.note: Ad-hoc max-width queries; 900px is the only structural one.

tokens.name: bp-nav
tokens.usage: At 900px and below the sidebar goes off-canvas; from 901px html and body are fixed height with inner scroll.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Most common small-screen query: header rows wrap, toggles go full width.
